sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch inventory-hygiene rebased onto the fleet sha at launch (after lastswing-01 is decided; hygiene keeps 3 spent pickaxes FOR last-swing)
notes: OWNER 2026-09-29: 'stop bots from collecting and keeping junk'. Measured 09-29 04:50Z: 47 of 80 bots at >= 34 estimated slots of 36; control bots hold ~178 NEVER_KEEP items each. THE CHANGE (70bf6a2 + 55222a4): pickupNearbyItems never walks to NEVER_KEEP ballast; at 34+ slots a deterministic `wear_out` work order destroys spent tools (EXACTLY 1 use) by using them once on a natural block (allowlist; ledge/sapling/cave/occupied-cell guards), keeping 3 spent pickaxes for last-swing, at most 4 per order, verified by count; a failed order backs off 30 min; wear_out is neither a milestone attempt nor a lessons success. Nothing is dropped, so nothing reaches another bot. Reviewed by Claude and Codex independently; 15 tests, 10 anchored mutants killed; 205/205. SANDBOX: '36 -> 32 slots: 4 of 4 worn out', 3 spent pickaxes kept, bot unmoved. WHY THE GATE IS CORRECTNESS: deterministic housekeeping; the fleet question is whether it ran and whether it ever destroyed something usable.

licence.note: The baseline has no wear_out skill or row kind. 47/80 bots are over the 34-slot trigger, so a 5-bot pool should fire within the first hour.

require.name: an active pool (tripwire, not a filter)

draw_exposure.note: drawexposure.py counts row kinds only and cannot see slot pressure. The dry run's pool hive-c sat at a median of 21 slots against 35 in control, so the OPERATOR checks before launch that the drawn pool has >= 2 bots at >= 34 estimated slots (hygieneread prints it); otherwise redraw. This is a manual step and is named here so it is not skipped.

exposure.note: Ready = at least one canary-build `_wear_out` success AND at least one control bot at >= 34 estimated slots (the slot estimator sees a presence).

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS. A tool copy with >= 2 uses present in the bot's snapshot before a `_wear_out` and gone after it. Deterministic; the pairing logic is asserted against a synthetic case before any fleet row.
CORRECTNESS. Fewer than min(3, before) spent pickaxes kept: last-swing loses its material.
The baseline cannot write `_wear_out`; a control row means the arms are wrong. No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS. No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE), never reverts.
POSITIVE CONTROL for the slot estimator (50 in the dry run). No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: DiD of median estimated slots (expected to fall) and junk_did (NEVER_KEEP items held per bot; expected to stop rising). pairs_missing_canary is reported: a wear_out with no snapshot within 120 s before cannot be checked and is named in the read.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.
